assumptions.bars: signal timeframe; inside a bar open -> adverse extreme -> favourable extreme -> close, so a bar touching a stop and TP1 is a stop; stops fill at their level or at a gapping open
assumptions.cost_model: spot-v1 for LONG, perp-v1 for SHORT
assumptions.entry: open of the bar after the signal
assumptions.funding: perp: default 0.0001 per 8 h against the position
assumptions.market: spot for LONG, perp for SHORT
assumptions.metric: test window only, every signal (no variant selection, overlap not removed)
assumptions.r_unit: distance from the fill to the preset stop (the live structural stop)

window.split: chronological; train trades exit before the cutoff, test trades signal at or after it
